_about: Guesses from a card's rules text: patterns matched, in any order, against a card's rules text (lower-cased). A card gets a row for every category one of its patterns matches, with that pattern's confidence (0 to 1, always below the 1.0 of a community tag). When a card matches several, the most confident wins, then the category higher in functional-tags.json. On a card Scryfall has tagged, a guess only adds a secondary role (it never replaces a community tag or becomes the main role). Lands are skipped. Edit, then restart; the guesses are recomputed.
